marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Friday.
marine.text:
Wind west 20 knots diminishing to light near midnight then
becoming north 15 early Friday morning. Snow changing to scattered flurries this evening and ending
Friday morning. Visibility 1 mile or less in snow. Temperatures near zero. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Tonight and Friday.
marine.text:
Over open water seas 1 metre or less building to 1 to 2 early
Friday evening.<br/>
